searchText: The halving time isn't that long. Something like 6 blocks or so (worst case scenario). Realistically it will take longer than that as you aren't likely to see 6 empty blocks in a row, but if demand falls off suddenly the base fee should adjust pretty fast. Yeah you're right (5 empties should get it ~97% of the way to halving). Practical for structural demand change, just does not have the same variance. Can no longer swindle in the heavy discount when fees are somewhat stable. Maybe that's a strict requirement for having an auction that allows for easy/cheaper instant transactions.
